text:
maria: FYI main is red, a bunch of integration tests failing with S3 proxy timeouts (mock-s3). job: https://ci.internal.redwood/12345 :grimacing:
ci-bot: Job 12345 detected 18 failing tests, first failure at step 'artifact-upload' -> timeout 30s
ton y: +1 seeing it, logs show 503 from mock-s3-proxy behind the test network bridge
maria: stack traces are all upload/download timeouts, e.g. `Error: Upload failed: write EPIPE` on the test helper
jen: is this the MinIO mock we run in the CI matrix? any recent changes to docker images? :thinking_face:
sami: I rolled a minor docker-base bump yesterday but only for runtime images, not mocks. however infra autoscaler restarted some runners ~2h ago
alex: I ran a quick curl to health endpoint from a repro runner:
```
curl -v http://mock-s3:9000/healthz
* About to connect() to mock-s3 port 9000 (#0)
*   Trying 10.0.8.14...
* Connected to mock-s3 (10.0.8.14) port 9000 (#0)
> GET /healthz HTTP/1.1
> Host: mock-s3:9000
>
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< Content-Type: text/plain
< Content-Length: 21
<
Mock S3 unavailable
```
alex: docker logs show repeated `accept tcp: use of closed network connection` from the proxy process
maria: can someone do a quick rerun on the matrix with skip-mock flag? we have a fallback path that runs tests against an external staging bucket. if that turns green we can isolate mock as culprit
jen: @tony can you rerun job 12345 with `SKIP_MOCK_S3=true` env? CI supports per-job env overrides in the UI
tony: started rerun with SKIP_MOCK_S3=true -> https://ci.internal.redwood/12346 :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: Rerun 12346 queued on runner-56, will report back
sami: also starting a telemetry check: ping/uptime for mock-s3 across all runners, pushing a quick script to infra repo to collect logs
maria: if rerun goes green we should mark as mock outage and roll a hotfix to restart the mock service on all runners
alex: quick mitigation idea: change the integration matrix to use `real-s3` for the artifact test shard until we root cause, low-risk, but we should not keep it long
jen: agreed. if green on rerun, i'll open an incident ticket and schedule a controlled restart for mock-s3 in CI images
ci-bot: Rerun 12346 completed: 154 passed, 0 failed :tada: (duration 12m)
maria: nice, that strongly suggests mock-s3 was the problem. thanks @tony for the fast rerun :heart:
sami: collected logs from three unhealthy runners, uploading to infra ticket: https://issues.internal.redwood/INFRA-782
alex: logs show proxy hitting fd leak in 1.2.0 image. comparing to previous image 1.1.8 that we rolled out last week
maria: action items: 1) pin mock-s3 image back to 1.1.8 in CI image build (sami) 2) restart mock service across runners (jen) 3) add healthcheck backoff + alert if 503 > 5m (tony) 4) followup postmortem in incidents (maria)
jen: I'll file the incident now and tag oncall, will add links to the CI jobs and logs  https://incidents.internal.redwood/2026-03-mock-s3
tony: adding a temporary test matrix override and a short RFC to avoid long-term reliance on the flaky mock :memo:
maria: cool — marking thread done for now. will update incident once infra ticket has image pinned. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
